full_prompt_en: A square fantastical landscape painting looks across a high garden terrace toward a domed observatory tower. The tower stands just right of center, with a white columned upper pavilion under a warm gray dome. A short telescope on a wooden tripod points diagonally through one open arch. Below, a tall rust-red brick section joins the pale stone structure. Stepped, sharply trimmed green hedges wrap around its base and descend toward the lower edge. Small stairways cut through the hedge terraces. Dark trees and a narrow spire fill the lower left, while a broader mass of woods spreads across the middle distance. Beyond them, a blue river winds toward a flat horizon marked by faint towers and pale fields. The sky occupies much of the composition. Soft pink-gold clouds cluster and streak across a clear medium-blue ground, with horizontal amber light close to the horizon. The tower is rendered with crisp architectural edges and small carved details, while distant land dissolves into fine atmospheric layers. Warm light touches the white columns, brick and cloud rims from the left. Hedge interiors and foreground tree clusters remain deep green and shadowed. The painting surface is carefully finished, with small grain and controlled texture in foliage and masonry. The composition rises in stages from the dark planted foreground through the red-white tower to the open sky, making the observatory the meeting point of exact built geometry and sweeping natural distance. The whole scene feels quietly marvelous, balanced by clear light and patient spatial order.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇想风景画越过高处花园露台，望向一座有穹顶的观测塔。塔略在中央右侧，白色列柱上层亭阁顶着暖灰色穹顶。一架木三脚架上的短望远镜从开放拱间斜指天空。下方高大的锈红砖段接住浅石色结构。层层修剪得笔直的绿篱环绕塔基，向下缘逐级下降。小阶梯从树篱台地中穿过。深色树木和一根窄尖塔填在左下方，更宽阔的林木团块铺满中景。越过它们，蓝色河流向平坦地平线蜿蜒，远方有淡淡塔楼和浅色田地。天空占据构图很大部分。柔软的粉金色云朵聚集并横扫中蓝天空，地平线附近有水平琥珀色光。观测塔以清楚建筑边缘和细小雕刻细节描出，远处土地则溶解为细微空气层。暖光从左边触及白柱、砖墙和云缘。树篱内部与前景树丛仍是深绿阴影。绘画表面处理细致，树叶与砌体带小颗粒和受控肌理。构图从深色植物前景，经过红白塔楼，逐层升入开放天空，让观测台成为准确建筑几何和宽展自然远方的交点。整幅景色安静而奇妙，由清楚光线和耐心的空间秩序平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a detailed, controlled fantasy painting surface with crisp geometric edges in the near structure and finely softened atmospheric distance. White and rust-red vertical masses stand amid tiered dark green forms, set against broad blue and pink-gold sky. Clear stepped planes create a measured ascent through the lower half. Small architectural marks and foliage texture reward close looking, while distant bands remain simplified and pale. Light arrives low and warm, catching exposed upper edges and cloud rims; shaded recesses retain deep cool color. The sky is open and spacious, with scattered soft-edged luminous clusters and horizontal light near the horizon. Perspective moves through a series of elevated terraces to long layered distance, making a relatively compact focal form feel connected to a vast landscape. Edges alternate between precise built boundaries and the soft expansion of air and cloud. The overall rhythm is orderly yet imaginative, with warm-cool contrast and tiered scale sustaining a calm sense of wonder.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细致、受控的奇想绘画表面，近处结构的几何边缘清楚，空气远方细腻柔化。白色与锈红竖向团块立于层叠深绿形体中，对着宽阔蓝色和粉金色天空。清楚的阶梯平面在画面下半部建立有度的上升路线。细小建筑笔痕与树叶肌理经得起近看，远方色带则简化而变浅。光从低处温暖地照来，接住暴露的上边缘和云缘；阴影凹处保留深冷色。天空开阔宽展，散布软边发光团块，地平线附近有水平光。透视经过一连串升高的平台抵达长远层次，让相对紧凑的焦点形体与广阔风景相连。边缘在准确的建造界线和空气与云朵柔软扩展之间交替。整体节奏有序又富想象力，冷暖对照与分层尺度支撑安静的奇妙感。
theme_en: A domed observatory tower rises from terraced hedges above a broad river valley beneath glowing clouds
theme_zh: 一座穹顶观测塔从层叠树篱中升起，俯临宽阔河谷和发亮云层
name: Evgeni Gordiets
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
